title: Pippin the Bunny Learns to Share: The Big Carrot Picnic!

lines.text: Hop, hop, hooray! Pippin the bunny found the biggest golden carrot in the forest!
lines.caps: Hop, hop, *HOORAY! | Pippin the bunny found the *BIGGEST | golden carrot in the *FOREST!

lines.text: It was sweet, crunchy, and bright orange! Mine, all mine, he cheered!
lines.caps: It was sweet, *CRUNCHY, | and bright orange! Mine, *ALL | mine, he *CHEERED!

lines.text: He hid behind a bush so none of his woodland friends could have a bite!
lines.caps: He hid behind a *BUSH | so none of his woodland *FRIENDS | could have a *BITE!

lines.text: He took one bite, then two bites... but eating in secret felt strangely quiet!
lines.caps: He took one *BITE, | then two bites... but eating in secret felt *STRANGELY | *QUIET!

lines.text: He looked across the meadow and saw his friends laughing and playing tag!
lines.caps: He looked across the *MEADOW | and saw his friends *LAUGHING | and playing *TAG!

lines.text: Pippin carried the big carrot over and snapped it into four juicy slices!
lines.caps: Pippin carried the big *CARROT | over and snapped it into four *JUICY | *SLICES!

lines.text: One for squirrel, one for hedgehog, one for puppy, and one for Pippin!
lines.caps: One for *SQUIRREL, | one for hedgehog, one for *PUPPY, | and one for *PIPPIN!

lines.text: Sharing treats turned a lonely snack into the best picnic ever!
lines.caps: Sharing treats turned a lonely *SNACK | into the *BEST | picnic *EVER!

lines.text: Share the joy and subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo for daily tales!
lines.caps: *SHARE the joy | and *SUBSCRIBE to | *BABYBEATS Rhymo | for daily *TALES!
